items.headline: Ethena Pay Launches Earn+ With 12% Target Yield
items.summary: Ethena Pay's new Earn+ vault targets up to 12% rewards via ~11x leveraged $ENA-ecosystem looping on Aave. Initial capacity is capped at $4.5M, with depositors bearing losses.

items.headline: $AVAIL Unveils ShieldTX to Block Hyperliquid Copy-Bots
items.summary: $AVAIL launched ShieldTX, a privacy tool for Hyperliquid perps that spins up a fresh wallet per position, making it harder for copy-trading bots to front-run whales.

items.headline: $PUMP Sets Nov. 9 Date for Elysium Trading In-App
items.summary: Pump.fun will add Elysium, a HyperEVM-settled rollup, to its app on Nov. 9, hot on the heels of its live Hyperliquid perps integration. $PUMP keeps expanding beyond memecoin launches.

items.headline: $ZIL CEO Quits as Bridge Exploit Probe Deepens
items.summary: Zilliqa's CEO stepped down as the board takes over amid a security probe. X-Bridge is shut in both directions and PlunderSwap reports losses across four $ZIL token pools.

items.headline: $KMNO Opens USDC Loans on Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Kamino now lets users borrow USDC against Backpack tokenized stocks at up to 40% LTV, a fresh DeFi use case for $KMNO on Solana with prices held outside US trading hours.
